llm_response.reason: The website displays classic scam hallmarks such as guaranteed and unrealistic high ROI (up to 80%), urgency tactics, anonymous and recently registered domain, ambiguous and generic company naming ('Website Name'), unverifiable testimonials, unclear privacy and company policy information, upfront deposit and referral requirements, and lack of legitimate business or contact details. These all strongly match multiple scam website characteristics, particularly those found in cryptocurrency and investment fraud strategies.
